1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube and positioned to enable reading without removal of the MTP from the test tube.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer is selected to withstand temperatures of -20°C or lower.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

13. (Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes configured for automated handling; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system is configured to track and manage sample data via the embedded MTP.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the system is adapted for low temperature operation such that the racks and test tubes are handled and stored at -20°C or less.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: heating the MTP to above the melting point of plastic; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to embed the MTP within the plastic.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing a test tube assembly with an embedded MTP; and reading the MTP without removing the test tube from a storage location.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein the vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer, and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer is selected to withstand temperatures of -20°C or lower.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
